messages:
alex_pm: Heads up — finalizing launch criteria for the upcoming GA. Need sign-off on SLA, docs, support coverage, monitoring, and pricing. Quick async sync so we have owners + decisions recorded. TL;DR proposal: hosted SLOs = 99.95% p95 latency; Dedicated = 99.9% uptime + QPS guarantees. Comments?

mira_eng: 99.95% p95 looks fine for small/medium models but risky for long seqs. We should gate by sequence-length buckets and model class. propose: p95 <300ms for <256 tokens, p95 <800ms for 1k tokens. Also call out tail-latency for streaming.

lee_sre: Agree with buckets. We'll need error-budget plumbing and a maintenance window policy. Also want automatic fallback policy to a compatible lower-cost model when capacity is constrained (graceful degradation).

toni_docs: Sounds good — I'll own the launch playbook docs. Checklist items I plan: SLA explainer page, API quickstart, migration guide, troubleshooting, runbooks for oncall, pricing FAQ, and a customer-facing SLA PDF. Any must-haves?

sam_support: From support POV: recommend 24/7 enterprise oncall + business-hours self-serve until we hit N enterprise customers. We need an escalation path for SLA credits/pricing disputes and a reproducible incident template for customers. Also training for L1 on common latency/error patterns.

raj_bizops: Pricing proposal (high level): three tiers — Pay-as-you-go, Reserved (monthly commit for Dedicated), Enterprise (flat-rate + support). Need commitment discounts and an ROI/cost calculator for customers. Docs should include examples for common usage patterns and cost estimates.

mira_eng: For monitoring, we need these telemetry events and labels: request_latency_ms, token_count, model_variant, kv_cache_hit, http_status, error_code. Also expose per-model p50/p95/p99 histograms and QPS. Quick snippet of metric names we expect: 

```
request_latency_ms
tokens_per_request
kv_hit_ratio
model_variant
http_status
error_code
```

lee_sre: Alerting rules proposal: any 5m window with >=5% error rate OR p95 latency > SLA target for 3 consecutive 5m windows -> P1. Also alert on sustained KV cache miss spikes. Include a runbook: degrade traffic to fallback model, notify account owner, open incident.

alex_pm: Owners (prelim): SLA eng lead = mira_eng, SRE oncall/runbooks = lee_sre, Docs = toni_docs, Support playbook = sam_support, Pricing & tiers = raj_bizops. Can each confirm owner + ETA for deliverable?

mira_eng: Confirm. I'll add model-specific latency baselines to the model catalog and deliver a short tech note by Mon.

toni_docs: Confirm. Draft playbook and customer-facing SLA doc by EOD Fri; will include sample API snippets and rollback steps.

sam_support: Confirm. Need a 1-hour training slot with eng to review runbooks — prefer Wed. Will draft L1 checklist this week.

raj_bizops: Confirm. I'll post pricing tier mockups and a cost calculator prototype by next Mon. Need product signoff on discounts.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: prod-readiness-checkset v1 ran — flagged issues: 2 lint warnings, missing SLA doc link.

alex_pm: Thanks. Next steps: I'll consolidate into the final launch checklist and post to #release-ops by Tue AM. If no objections in 48h, this becomes the GA acceptance criteria (SLA + docs + support + monitoring + pricing). :thumbsup:

lee_sre: One more ask — add data retention & audit log requirements for Private deployments (KMS/HSM), and ensure audit logs are surfaced in the console.

mira_eng: noted — will add privacy/compliance bullets to the SLA doc and include HSM/KMS integration notes.

toni_docs: Will add a short compliance appendix for Private customers.

alex_pm: Great. If anyone sees a blocker for their deliverable, drop it here or DM me. Otherwise I'll publish the checklist after consolidating inputs. :rocket:
